info.name: Mistral OCR
info.summary: Send files and images to the Mistral OCR API to extract machine-readable Markdown text
info.description:
Integrates the Mistral OCR API into Nextcloud:
- Task Processing provider for `core:image2text:ocr` (usable from the Assistant app, Talk and any Task Processing consumer) - "Recognize text with Mistral OCR" file action in the Files app - Flow (workflow engine) operation for automatic OCR on file created / updated / tag assigned - Sidecar Markdown output (`<name>.md`), task-result output, or file description
The Mistral API key is stored encrypted via the AppAPI secrets mechanism and is never logged or returned by API responses. An EU endpoint (`https://api.eu.mistral.ai`) is supported for data residency. See the README for the data-flow diagram and GDPR notes.
info.author: Deltadrai
